'''Pokémon Adventures RGB volume 1''' (Japanese: '''ポケットモンスターSPECIAL pbk-edition 赤緑青編 1''' ''Pocket Monsters Special Paperback Edition Red, Green & Blue Chapter volume 1'') is the first volume of an omnibus compilation of the {{MangaArc|Red, Green & Blue}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. It is authored by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and illustrated by [[Mato]].

==Major events==
{{spoilers}}
* {{adv|Red}} meets {{adv|Blue}}.
* {{adv|Professor Oak}} gives Red and Blue each a [[Pokédex]].
* {{adv|Bill}} helps Red with his [[Pokémon Storage System]].
* Red meets {{adv|Green}}.
* Red and Blue accidentally swap their Pokémon.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
The following Pokémon are obtained:
* Red's {{p|Nidorino}} in [[PS001]].
* Red's {{p|Bulbasaur}} "[[Saur]]" in [[PS002]].
* Red's {{p|Pikachu}} "[[Pika]]" in [[PS004]].
* Red's {{p|Fearow}} in [[PS009]].
* Red's {{p|Snorlax}} "[[Snor]]" in [[PS012]].
* Blue's {{p|Porygon}} in [[PS018]].
* Red's {{p|Diglett}} in [[PS018]].
* Red's {{p|Krabby}} in [[PS018]].
* Blue's {{p|Ninetales}} in [[PS018]].
* Red's {{p|Eevee}} "[[Vee]]" in [[PS019]].
* Red obtains several Pokémon from the Safari Zone in [[PS022]].

===Evolutions===
The following Pokémon evolve:
* Blue's {{p|Charmander}} evolves into {{TP|Blue|Charmeleon}} sometime between [[PS003]] and [[PS005]].
* Red's {{p|Poliwhirl}} evolves into {{p|Poliwrath}} in [[PS011]].
* Red's {{p|Bulbasaur}} ("[[Saur]]") evolves into {{p|Ivysaur}} in [[PS015]].
* Blue's {{p|Machoke}} evolves into {{p|Machamp}} in [[PS018]].

==Gym battles==
Red defeats the following Gym Leaders:
* [[Brock]] in [[PS005]]
* [[Koga]] in [[PS007]] (unknowingly, no Badge gained)
* [[Misty]] in [[PS008]]
* [[Lt. Surge]] in [[PS011]] (does not get a Badge)
* [[Erika]] in [[PS020]]
